words.definitionEn: the period of time in a person's life when they are developing into an adult
words.exampleEn: She had a troubled [adolescence].

words.definitionEn: the part of someone's life when they are an adult
words.exampleEn: Responsibility, I suppose, is what defines [adulthood].

words.definitionEn: a close connection joining two or more people
words.exampleEn: the [bond](s) of friendship/love

words.definitionEn: a feeling of shared interests and support among men, or more generally, among all humans
words.exampleEn: The ideal of the [brotherhood] of man (= where everyone loves each other) is still far from reality.

words.definitionEn: the particular combination of qualities in a person or place that makes them different from others
words.exampleEn: Politeness is traditionally part of the British [character].

words.definitionEn: the time when someone is a child
words.exampleEn: She had an unhappy [childhood].

words.definitionEn: an active disagreement between people with opposing opinions or principles
words.exampleEn: There was a lot of [conflict] between him and his father.

words.meaningVi: mối quan hệ, sự liên quan
words.definitionEn: relation
words.exampleEn: The [connection] between smoking and heart disease is well known.

words.definitionEn: the state or time of being a father
words.exampleEn: [Fatherhood] is a lifelong responsibility.
Their [friendship] goes back to when they were at school together.

words.definitionEn: the way people or animals naturally react or behave, without having to think or learn about it
words.exampleEn: Her first [instinct] was to run.

words.definitionEn: an occasion when two or more people or things communicate with or react to each other
words.exampleEn: There's not enough [interaction] between the management and the workers.

words.definitionEn: the state or time of being a mother
words.exampleEn: I don't feel ready for [motherhood] yet.

words.definitionEn: a person's character
words.exampleEn: As a child, Juliana had a very sensitive [nature].

words.definitionEn: mother or father
words.exampleEn: I'm going to meet Richard's [parent]s for the first time this weekend.

words.meaningVi: sự liên quan, mối quan hệ
words.definitionEn: = relationship /rɪˈleɪ.ʃən.ʃɪp/= connection
words.exampleEn: The word [relation] is useful in IELTS.

words.definitionEn: a member of your family
words.exampleEn: All her close/distant [relative]s came to the wedding.

words.definitionEn: look like
words.exampleEn: There was a clear family [resemblance] between all the brothers.

words.definitionEn: a situation in which people, businesses, etc. compete with each other for the same thing
words.exampleEn: There's such [rivalry] among/between my three sons.

words.definitionEn: a brother or sister
words.exampleEn: There was great [sibling] rivalry (= competition) between Peter and his brother.

words.definitionEn: a young person between 13 and 19 years old
words.exampleEn: The magazine is aimed at [teenager]s and young adults.
a fiery [temperament] ( tính khí nóng nảy)

words.definitionEn: the friendly feelings that people have for other eople, or special connections with places
words.exampleEn: Family [ties] are weaker if you move a long way away.

words.meaningVi: sự nuôi dưỡng, sự dạy dỗ
words.exampleEn: Who can argue with the healthy [upbringing] of happy children?
In both cases, individuals can play an [active] role, or can be silent.

words.meaningVi: a family unit that includes grandmothers, grandfathers, aunts, and uncles, etc. in addition to parents and children
words.definitionEn: = traditional family
words.exampleEn: He has a very large [extended] family.
Of course I made the pie, i make it for every holiday [family] gathering and have for years.

words.definitionEn: your closest relations, such as your parents, children, husband, or wife
words.exampleEn: The funeral was attended by her [immediate] family (= her parents, children, brothers and sisters) only.

words.definitionEn: /ˈɪn.stɪŋkt/
words.exampleEn: It is therefore difficult to assess what was being referred to by [maternal] instinct.

words.word: Sibling rivalry: sự ganh đua giữa anh
words.exampleEn: There was great [sibling] rivalry (= competition) between Peter and his brother.
That is largely learnt from your parents – a result of a "[stable]" upbringing.
He also bears a [striking] resemblance to his father.

words.definitionEn: having direct family connections or shared beliefs, support, and sympathy
words.exampleEn: In those early months, there's a very [close] bond between mother and child.
a [close-knit] family/community
Her [maternal] grandmother (= mother's mother) is still alive.
My [paternal] grandparents (= my father's parents) were Irish.

words.definitionEn: satisfying or beneficial
words.exampleEn: a [rewarding] experience

words.meaningVi: cung cấp cho ai đó thứ gì
words.definitionEn: to give what is needed to someone
words.exampleEn: We certainly try to [accommodate] students with disabilities.

words.meaningVi: nhận con nuôi/ áp dụng ( cái gì đó mới)
words.definitionEn: to legally take another person's child into your own family and take care of him or her as your own child
words.exampleEn: They've [adopt]ed a baby girl.

words.meaningVi: mối quan hệ bị đổ vỡ.
words.definitionEn: If a system, relationship, or discussion breaks down, it fails because there is a problem or disagreement

They will have to be more flexible and [develop] new skills.

words.definitionEn: to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful

There is a strong need to [establish] effective communication links between staff, parents, pupils, and external bodies.

words.definitionEn: to share interests, experiences, or other characteristics with someone or something

words.meaningVi: thừa hưởng ( tài sản, ngoại hình, tính cách)

words.definitionEn: to communicate with or react to

words.definitionEn: the physical or mental power or skill needed to do something

words.definitionEn: a young person who is developing into an adult

words.definitionEn: the way that someone behaves

words.definitionEn: a principle or idea

words.definitionEn: a result of a particular action or situation, often one that is bad or not convenient

words.definitionEn: the ability to form pictures in the mind

words.definitionEn: the time when someone is a baby or a very young child
words.exampleEn: Her youngest child died in [infancy].

words.definitionEn: a baby or a very young child
words.exampleEn: a newborn [infant].

words.definitionEn: the quality of behaving mentally and emotionally like an adult
words.exampleEn: How long does it take for the chicks to grow to [maturity]?
a good/bad [memory]

words.definitionEn: an important event in the development or history of something or in someone's life
words.exampleEn: He felt that moving out of his parents' home was a real [milestone] in his life.
Do you think it's true that teenage girls are less self-confident than their male [peer]s?

words.definitionEn: a length of time

words.definitionEn: any stage in a series of events or in a process of development
words.exampleEn: The project is only in its initial [phase] as yet, but it's looking quite promising..
The drug has a high success/failure [rate].

words.meaningVi: cái nhắc nhở ( để nhớ làm điều gì)
words.definitionEn: a written or spoken message that reminds someone to do something
words.exampleEn: If he forgot to pay his rent, his landlady would send him a [reminder].
[Social] skills are what employers need most.
The project is in its final stages and should be completed by August.

words.definitionEn: a young child, especially one who is learning or has recently learned to walk
words.exampleEn: Are these toys suitable for [toddler]s?

words.meaningVi: sự chuyển tiếp ( từ giai đoạn này sang giai đoạn kia)
words.definitionEn: a change from one form or type to another, or the process by which this happens
words.exampleEn: The [transition] from boyhood to manhood can be a confusing period.
Truth and beauty are [abstract] concepts.
